data.content:
I sent four disputes, worth $79.15 in deductions. DD-51102 is the biggest deduction ($46.80), but it's weak without the order ticket, so I haven't drafted it. The next deadline is 2026-11-24, 10 days out.

**Sent (you approved each one)**

| Case | Amount | Win chance | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% | The ticket lists the item. Pickup was 3 minutes after the order was ready. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 70% | The ticket lists the item. The order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 82% | The ticket lists the item. The order was ready at 18:36 and picked up at 18:40. |

- **Ticket wording:** For DD-51115 and DD-51123, the ticket only shows the item was ordered, not that it was packed. The disputes mention the ticket in the text and rely on the pickup times as evidence.
- **Repeat claims:** The same account made 3 claims this period (DD-51123, DD-51131 and DD-51140). I kept that count out of the disputes so nothing reads as a comment on the customer.

**Weak, needs something from you**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80, 35%):** There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't check the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray against the order. Please send a photo of the ticket for this order. The case is worth redoing if you can find it.

**Not investigated**
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** Both are at 60% but fell outside the top 5 cases I check. I can look at them next if you want.

**Skipped**
- **DD-51171 ($11.00):** The win chance is only 15%.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** The deadline passed 11 days ago and there is nothing to recover.

**Past disputes**
- **DD-51115 and DD-51123:** Both match an earlier pattern in memory: "Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won." and "Same pattern again: ticket and handoff times were enough." Two of the three similar past cases won. The third lost because the claim named a side item not itemised on the ticket.
- **DD-51152:** The past cases involved tickets that list the item, and here the ticket omits it. That's a different pattern, so I didn't lean on the history.
- **DD-51131:** It's a wrong-item claim and there is no history for that claim type.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`. Tell me how each dispute turns out and I'll record the results so future triage learns from them.
